entries.zh: 12 分钟限时，反复复活，按个人质量结算排名。
entries.en: Timed 12 minutes, respawn repeatedly, ranked by personal mass.

entries.zh: 10 队 4 人，队友可接分身，按队伍总质量结算。
entries.en: 10 teams of 4, teammates can catch splits, ranked by total team mass.

entries.zh: 64 人生命制，吞噬加命，生命耗尽出局。
entries.en: 64 players with lives, eating adds a life, and you are out when lives run out.

entries.zh: 100 人开局，安全区收缩，圈外掉质量，活到最后。
entries.en: 100 players start, the safe zone shrinks, mass drains outside it, last one standing wins.

entries.zh: 高密度食点和密集事件，节奏更快，3 分钟左右结算。
entries.en: Dense food and frequent events, a faster pace, results in about 3 minutes.

entries.zh: 48 人孢子刺战场，所有刺都会炸出一圈可争夺孢子。
entries.en: 48-player spore-spike arena; every spike bursts into a ring of contestable spores.

entries.zh: 22 人方形战场，A 快合、D 冲刺种刺，88% 区域占领获胜。
entries.en: 22-player square arena: A merges fast, D dashes and plants spikes, 88% area control wins.

entries.zh: 4 队 7 人争夺 3 个星核据点，先到目标分获胜。
entries.en: 4 teams of 7 fight over 3 star-core outposts; first to the target score wins.

entries.zh: 36 人巨球开局，88% 固定区域占领并维持 6 秒决定胜负。
entries.en: 36 players start as giant balls; hold 88% of a fixed area for 6 seconds to win.

entries.zh: 勇者阵营围攻魔王和魔兵，限时吞掉魔王获胜。
entries.en: The Heroes besiege the Boss and its minions; devour the Boss within the time limit to win.

entries.zh: 12 分钟限时，反复复活，按个人质量结算排名。
entries.en: Timed 12 minutes, respawn repeatedly, ranked by personal mass.

entries.zh: 10 队 4 人，队友可接分身，按队伍总质量结算。
entries.en: 10 teams of 4, teammates can catch splits, ranked by total team mass.

entries.zh: 64 人生命制，吞噬加命，生命耗尽出局。
entries.en: 64 players with lives, eating adds a life, and you are out when lives run out.

entries.zh: 100 人开局，安全区持续收缩，圈外掉质量，活到最后。
entries.en: 100 players start, the safe zone keeps shrinking, mass drains outside it, last one standing wins.

entries.zh: 3 分钟高密度发育，随机事件密集触发，适合快速爽局。
entries.en: 3 minutes of dense growth with frequent random events, great for quick rounds.

entries.zh: 48 人孢子刺战场，所有刺都会炸出一圈可争夺孢子。
entries.en: 48-player spore-spike arena; every spike bursts into a ring of contestable spores.

entries.zh: 22 人方形战场，64 分身上限，用 A 快合、D 冲刺种刺完成区域霸屏。
entries.en: 22-player square arena, 64 split limit; use A to merge fast and D to dash and plant spikes to dominate the area.

entries.zh: 4 队 7 人争夺 3 个星核据点，站入据点压制进度，先到目标分获胜。
entries.en: 4 teams of 7 fight over 3 star-core outposts; stand in one to push progress, first to the target score wins.

entries.zh: 全员巨球开局，低密度固定圆形战场，连续保持霸屏进度即可获胜。
entries.en: Everyone starts as a giant ball in a low-density fixed round arena; keep your domination progress up to win.

entries.zh: 勇者阵营合作发育，击败超大魔王和魔兵，限时吞掉魔王获胜。
entries.en: The Heroes grow together, defeat the huge Boss and its minions, and win by devouring the Boss in time.

entries.zh: 吃点范围暴涨但移速略降

entries.zh: 合体更快且移动微加速
entries.en: Faster merging and slightly faster movement

entries.zh: 吃点范围和高价值食点提升
entries.en: Bigger pickup range and more high-value food

entries.zh: 吃点范围暴涨但移动变沉
entries.en: Pickup range soars but movement gets heavy

entries.zh: 刺球持续涌入，适合炸刺翻盘
entries.en: Spikes keep flooding in, good for a spike-pop comeback

entries.zh: 中心区域落下大颗资源
entries.en: Big resources drop in the center

entries.zh: 全场 AI 更敢追击和分身
entries.en: All AI chase and split more boldly

entries.zh: 孢子刺球出现，碰到会喷出一部分质量

entries.zh: 战术刺球更频繁，适合围追反打
entries.en: Tactical spikes appear more often, good for chasing and counters

entries.en: Daily supply Stardust, XP and tickets grow with level.

entries.zh: 每级提高人品积累速度。
entries.en: Raises luck gain speed per level.

entries.zh: 每级同时提高开局质量、星尘结算和每日补给。
entries.en: Each level raises starting mass, Stardust payout and daily supply together.
